description: Cryptographic primitives for the DecentralChain blockchain — Curve25519 key generation and signing, Blake2b256 / Keccak256 / SHA256 hashing, Base16 / Base58 / Base64 encoding, RSA verify, BLS utilities, and Merkle tree construction. Forked from Decentral-America/crypto v2.0.7 with full upstream history and DCC production hardening.
